errors.text: The proposed ferromagnetic Ti- or Al-rich B2 precipitate is not supported by the cited evidence for the Fe-Co-Ni-Ti fcc system; the closest evidence concerns a predominantly B2 Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni alloy with A2 nanoparticles.
The hypothesis does not reconstruct the key C14 Laves phase, Ti-sublattice antiferromagnetic coupling, or the experimentally relevant high-temperature fcc transition near 1084 K.
The proposed measurements correlate B2 precipitation with coercivity but do not directly assign the magnetic transitions or coercivity to the fcc versus secondary phase.
